correction_notes: Rejected the first candidate because document and review-table glyphs resembled pseudo-writing; the accepted successor replaces them with non-text evidence tokens while preserving the dual-lane mechanism.
mechanism_notes: Pull-request changes split into an enforceable rules-based lane and a separate nonblocking AI advisory lane. Both converge at human security review before repair verification and the merge decision; excluded PR classes remain attached only to the advisory path.
